id: LET IT DIE Crossover Content v3.79
name: LET IT DIE Crossover Content v3.79
description: 50 decal-pool entries and 32 blueprint quests, with the 287 artwork packages they need. Database changes recorded from the pack's own v3.79 installer; artwork from the pack itself, as refreshed for game 1.91.
author: S3er0i9ng

settings.label: DUKE-WoT Sniper Rifle04
settings.help: The DUKE-WoT Sniper Rifle04 blueprint quest and its research. On: they can be found and researched. Off: the quests are expired and the research closed, as S3er0i9ng's own manager does it. The gear's models and item definitions stay, so anything you already own keeps working; switch it back on to get the quests and research again.
